known.title: Keep the Python starter's required formatting check passing

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - initialize a Python app and run its test command.
This call puts both arguments on a 94-character line. The starter's apps/api/pyproject.toml:78 leaves Ruff at its [default 88-column width](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#line-length), so the formatter splits these arguments onto separate lines. The shipped package.json:11 requires `ruff format --check`, which [exits nonzero for unformatted files](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/formatter/#ruff-format). Since package.json:17 runs lint before the API tests, this blocks the normal Python starter test command and its smoke CI. Format this call before shipping it.
